--- header_pre ---
#define j0 _j0
#define j1 _j1
#define jn _jn
#define y0 _y0
#define y1 _y1
#define yn _yn
#define gamma _gamma
#define lgamma _lgamma
#define tgamma _tgamma
#include <stddef.h>
#if defined(__APPLE__)
#include <OpenGL/gl.h>
#include <OpenGL/glu.h>
#include <GLUT/glut.h>
#else
#define GL_GLEXT_PROTOTYPES
#include <GL/gl.h>
#include <GL/glext.h>
#include <GL/glu.h>
#include <GL/freeglut.h>
#endif
#include <math.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#undef j0
#undef j1
#undef jn
#undef y0
#undef y1
#undef yn
#undef gamma
#undef lgamma
#undef tgamma

#ifndef M_PI
#define M_PI 3.14159265358979323846
#endif

static float g_angle = 0.0f;
static int   g_rotating = 0;

--- display_header ---
void display(void) {
  glLoadIdentity();
  glPushAttrib(GL_ALL_ATTRIB_BITS);
--- lights_pre_camera ---
--- camera ---
  // camera
  glTranslatef(0.0000f, 0.0000f, -9.2000f);
  glRotatef(7.0000f, 1.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f);
  glRotatef(-14.0000f, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0.0f);
  glTranslatef(-0.0000f, -0.2000f, -0.0000f);
--- header_post ---
--- render_state ---
  glEnable(GL_MULTISAMPLE);
  glDisable(GL_LINE_SMOOTH);
  float A[16], B[16], C[16];
--- source ---
  static float tickRate = 1.4; // beats per second @tune
  static float swingAmp = 20; // pendulum swing, degrees @tune
  static float u, stepA, swing, rock, side;
  static float aE, a1, a2, a3;

  // --- gear(n, rp): rim + 4 spokes + n teeth as radial cubes. Tooth size is
  // constant because every wheel shares the same module. ---
  gear(n, rp) {
    glPushMatrix();
      glScalef(1, 1, 0.5);
      glutSolidTorus(0.11, rp - 0.14, 10, 44);
    glPopMatrix();
    glPushMatrix();
      glScalef(0.14, 0.14, 0.3);
      glutSolidSphere(1, 16, 12);
    glPopMatrix();
    for(i, 0, 4) {
      glPushMatrix();
        glRotatef(i*90 + 45, 0, 0, 1);
        glTranslatef(rp*0.45, 0, 0);
        glScalef(rp*0.8, 0.08, 0.09);
        glutSolidCube(1);
      glPopMatrix();
    }
    for(i, 0, n) {
      glPushMatrix();
        glRotatef(i*360/n, 0, 0, 1);
        glTranslatef(rp, 0, 0);
        glScalef(0.17, 0.11, 0.13);
        glutSolidCube(1);
      glPopMatrix();
    }
  }

  // --- escWheel(n, rp): like gear() but with slanted ratchet teeth, so the
  // faces the anchor pallets catch are visually obvious. ---
  escWheel(n, rp) {
    glPushMatrix();
      glScalef(1, 1, 0.4);
      glutSolidTorus(0.09, rp - 0.1, 10, 40);
    glPopMatrix();
    glPushMatrix();
      glScalef(0.12, 0.12, 0.26);
      glutSolidSphere(1, 16, 12);
    glPopMatrix();
    for(i, 0, 4) {
      glPushMatrix();
        glRotatef(i*90, 0, 0, 1);
        glTranslatef(rp*0.42, 0, 0);
        glScalef(rp*0.74, 0.07, 0.08);
        glutSolidCube(1);
      glPopMatrix();
    }
    for(i, 0, n) {
      glPushMatrix();
        glRotatef(i*360/n, 0, 0, 1);
        glTranslatef(rp - 0.02, 0, 0);
        glRotatef(35, 0, 0, 1);
        glScalef(0.2, 0.05, 0.1);
        glutSolidCube(1);
      glPopMatrix();
    }
  }

  // --- axle(): brass arbor pin capped by a synthetic-ruby jewel bearing ---
  axle() {
    glColor3f(0.78, 0.6, 0.24);
    glPushMatrix();
      glScalef(0.06, 0.06, 1.15);
      glutSolidCube(1);
    glPopMatrix();
    glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_EMISSION, (GLfloat[]){0.22, 0.01, 0.04, 1});
    glColor3f(0.6, 0.05, 0.12);
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(0, 0, 0.62);
      glutSolidSphere(0.055, 12, 10);
    glPopMatrix();
    glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_EMISSION, (GLfloat[]){0, 0, 0, 1});
  }

  // ===== Clockwork gear train - a ticking escapement drives exact ratios =====
  // The pendulum beats, the anchor rocks, and the escape wheel advances one
  // tooth per beat. Every other wheel is slaved to it through exact tooth
  // ratios (angle_b = -angle_a * Na/Nb + half-pitch offset), so the whole
  // train ticks forward together. All gears share module 2*rp/n = 0.075, so
  // any two mesh when their centers sit exactly rp1 + rp2 apart.

  glClearColor(0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1);
  glEnable(GL_DEPTH_TEST);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glEnable(GL_NORMALIZE);
  glEnable(GL_COLOR_MATERIAL);
  glColorMaterial(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_AMBIENT_AND_DIFFUSE);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT0);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT1);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHT2);
  glShadeModel(GL_SMOOTH);
  glLightModeli(GL_LIGHT_MODEL_TWO_SIDE, 1);
  glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SPECULAR, (GLfloat[]){0.85, 0.8, 0.65, 1});
  glMaterialf(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_SHININESS, 55);

  // Beat clock: u counts beats. The escape wheel snaps one 15-degree tooth
  // forward during the first 1/7th of each beat (floor + clamped ramp), then
  // dwells -- tick, tock. The pendulum is fastest at the release instant,
  // exactly like a real deadbeat escapement.
  u = t*tickRate;
  stepA = floor(u) + min(1, fmod(u, 1)*7);
  swing = swingAmp*sin(PI*u);
  rock = 9*sin(PI*u);
  // The train. Each wheel counter-rotates its driver, scaled by the tooth
  // ratio; the half-pitch constants (180/N: 5, 10, 15) interleave the teeth.
  aE = -stepA*15;
  a1 = -aE*24/36 + 5;
  a2 = -a1*36/18 + 10;
  a3 = -a2*18/12 + 15;

  // Walnut back panel
  glColor3f(0.23, 0.17, 0.12);
  glBegin(GL_QUADS);
    glNormal3f(0, 0, 1);
    glVertex3f(-3.5, -3, -0.85);
    glVertex3f(3.5, -3, -0.85);
    glVertex3f(3.5, 3.2, -0.85);
    glVertex3f(-3.5, 3.2, -0.85);
  glEnd();

  // Escape wheel: 24 steel ratchet teeth, one per beat
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(-1.35, 1.15, 0);
    axle();
    glRotatef(aE, 0, 0, 1);
    glColor3f(0.62, 0.66, 0.72);
    escWheel(24, 0.9);
  glPopMatrix();

  // Center wheel, brass: 36T meshing the escape wheel from below (24:36)
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(-1.35, -1.1, 0);
    axle();
    glRotatef(a1, 0, 0, 1);
    glColor3f(0.8, 0.62, 0.26);
    gear(36, 1.35);
  glPopMatrix();

  // Second wheel, copper: 18T, geared up 2:1 off the center wheel
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(0.675, -1.1, 0);
    axle();
    glRotatef(a2, 0, 0, 1);
    glColor3f(0.72, 0.42, 0.28);
    gear(18, 0.675);
  glPopMatrix();

  // Third wheel, steel: 12T, the fast end of the train (7s per turn)
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(1.8, -1.1, 0);
    axle();
    glRotatef(a3, 0, 0, 1);
    glColor3f(0.66, 0.7, 0.76);
    gear(12, 0.45);
  glPopMatrix();

  // Anchor: rocks on the beat; ruby pallets dip between the ratchet teeth
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(-1.35, 2.42, 0);
    glRotatef(rock, 0, 0, 1);
    glColor3f(0.62, 0.66, 0.72);
    glPushMatrix();
      glScalef(0.09, 0.09, 0.22);
      glutSolidSphere(1, 12, 10);
    glPopMatrix();
    for(i, 0, 2) {
      side = i*2 - 1;
      glPushMatrix();
        glRotatef(-90 + side*38, 0, 0, 1);
        glColor3f(0.62, 0.66, 0.72);
        glPushMatrix();
          glTranslatef(0.25, 0, 0);
          glScalef(0.5, 0.07, 0.08);
          glutSolidCube(1);
        glPopMatrix();
        glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_EMISSION, (GLfloat[]){0.22, 0.01, 0.04, 1});
        glColor3f(0.6, 0.05, 0.12);
        glPushMatrix();
          glTranslatef(0.5, 0, 0);
          glScalef(0.12, 0.05, 0.09);
          glutSolidCube(1);
        glPopMatrix();
        glMaterialfv(GL_FRONT_AND_BACK, GL_EMISSION, (GLfloat[]){0, 0, 0, 1});
      glPopMatrix();
    }
  glPopMatrix();

  // Pendulum: steel rod + brass bob, swinging behind the train
  glPushMatrix();
    glTranslatef(-1.35, 2.42, -0.55);
    glRotatef(swing, 0, 0, 1);
    glColor3f(0.55, 0.58, 0.64);
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(0, -1.7, 0);
      glScalef(0.055, 3.4, 0.055);
      glutSolidCube(1);
    glPopMatrix();
    glColor3f(0.83, 0.66, 0.3);
    glPushMatrix();
      glTranslatef(0, -3.35, 0);
      glScalef(1, 1, 0.45);
      glutSolidSphere(0.42, 24, 18);
    glPopMatrix();
  glPopMatrix();

  // Tooth-count labels sit beside their wheels
  glDisable(GL_LIGHTING);
  glColor3f(0.85, 0.8, 0.62);
  glRasterPos3f(-2.95, 1.05, 0.3);
  label("%fT", 24);
  glRasterPos3f(-1.5, -2.75, 0.3);
  label("%fT", 36);
  glRasterPos3f(0.5, -2.05, 0.3);
  label("%fT", 18);
  glRasterPos3f(1.65, -1.85, 0.3);
  label("%fT", 12);
  glEnable(GL_LIGHTING);
